newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bavaria called a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bavaria called a buy.

text.p: Ing Barings said Tuesday that it maintained its buy recommendation for Colombian brewing giant Bavaria, flagship of the Santo Domingo business group.
It said Bavaria's share price, which has risen 63.6 percent in dollar terms so far this year, had reached its historical high and outperformed the Colombia index by 89.5 percent.
But it also noted that Bavaria's price earnings ratio remains at a discount to the Colombian market and was at half the Latin American sector average.
ING Barings also said its year-end price target for Bavaria was $8.3, which would imply a 25 percent dollar upside.
In a related development, brokerage Suvalor said Bavaria was Colombia's top company Tuesday in terms of assets, sales and net profits.

It noted that low growth in sales achieved by Bavaria in 1996, which corresponded to 17.22 percent in nominal terms, did not prevent the company from increasing its operating income by an impressive 41.8 percent.
Suvalor, which is owned by the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, said it sees Bavaria increasing its net profit by 17.6 percent this year to a total of 252.5 billion pesos.
